scope: Kp-to-distribution-volume output propagation; not measured whole-body Vss validation
exploratory_endpoint: 11-tissue distribution-volume contribution plus blood volume under Rb=1

physiology_source.citation: Ball et al., Pharmaceutics 2014, Table 1; 250-g rat values sourced there from Brown et al. 1997

protocol_amendment.decision: Scaffold D-MPNN remains in the observed-panel analysis but is excluded from full-grid inference because checkpoints were not retained and deterministic retraining did not reproduce the canonical predictions (maximum absolute difference 0.428791 log10).
protocol_amendment.interpretive_effect: No scaffold full-grid values are reported; this avoids substituting a different fitted model after observing the discrepancy.

interpretation_constraints: The 11-tissue endpoint omits residual tissues and does not establish absolute whole-body Vss accuracy.
The blood term assumes blood-to-plasma ratio of 1 because compound-specific ratios are unavailable.
PT and RR are evaluated only on their respective literature tissue panels.
The five complete 11-tissue experimental profiles are exploratory only.
